purpose: Per-channel Slack observation -> private A9 archive -> evidence-gated public-safe structured Operations state -> validated website -> company/project Slack communication; every delivery is receipt-verified.

collection.resume_rule: Use last provider-verified per-channel message_ts/cursor from private archive manifest; do NOT assume midnight, 24 hours, or previous chat response is exhaustive.
collection.source_window_boundaries: Record inclusive oldest and exclusive latest per channel and the cutoff NPT for each run.
collection.bootstrap_when_cursor_missing: Read bounded provider history and mark coverage PARTIAL until archived/readback-verified; never invent a cursor.
collection.thread_policy: Capture messages AND replies; revisit tracked older parent threads for replies after cursor; deduplicate by workspace_id + channel_id + message_ts.
collection.retention_backfill_policy: Detect gaps/late replies and queue governed catch-up; never silently skip channels or claim COMPLETE.
collection.original_text: Preserve original Unicode Slack text/language in PRIVATE Drive raw JSONL only; normalized fields may use English controlled vocabularies; translations never replace originals.
collection.excluded_from_truth: Outbound tracker posts, instructions, plans, reactions, reported intent, delivery receipts and raw discussion are not automatically confirmed work.
collection.sensitive_content: Private messages, personal data, private finance and restricted evidence must never be placed in the public GitHub repository or Pages assets.
collection.archive_rule: Reuse existing A9 Slack archive; never create a parallel archive. Preserve existing B001-B004 history and unresolved file/binary recovery debt.

coverage.project_channel_scope: Resolve ALL active governed project channels from the private Slack ChannelRegistry, not only project IDs currently appearing in Daily Ops JSON.
coverage.unprojected_project_policy: Recognize governed channel-level projects missing from public projects.csv as COVERAGE_GAP/NOT_PROJECTED; preserve observations privately and request owning project-master admission, never invent missing GitHub IDs or statuses.
coverage.company_separation: REB and FBL summaries are separately routed; do not share private company facts or mention REB recipients in FBL channels.

admission.supported_input: Slack provider verified source, owning project/Drive authority, current approved project controls
admission.terminology: ORDERED != RECEIVED != IN_STOCK != CONSUMED; PLAN != STARTED != DONE != ENGINEER_ACCEPTED
admission.public_repository_rule: Admit only appropriately public-safe normalized facts; private site information requires gated Drive/backend instead, not client-side filtering.
admission.immutable_source_rule: Private raw archived Slack messages cannot be rewritten to force agreement with current interpretations.

publication.website_source: Canonical GitHub public-safe JSON/JSONL/CSV, never manually duplicated HTML facts.

slack_delivery.project_channels: Concise per-site questions from supported current facts; one daily tracker per channel unless meaningful follow-up; deduplicate exact date/channel.
slack_delivery.company_channels: Concise REB/FBL company rollup of cross-site priorities, blockers, decisions and deep links; do not copy every project transcript.
slack_delivery.authorization: Preserve live Slack READ FIRST send gate; any automatic source-triggered delivery stays disabled unless existing A9 owner-approved routing/source binding/pilot QA permits it.
slack_delivery.readback: After each authorized post verify provider message_ts/permalink and log receipt in existing private MessageLog and public-safe run receipt.
slack_delivery.company_rollup_missing: Mark MISSING/NOT_SENT rather than claim delivery.

run_closeout.handle_unverified: Retain unresolved debt and next exact safe boundary; scheduler remains enabled.
